patient_sentences.text: A 58-year-old woman presents with two days of exertional chest pressure.
She has hypertension and obesity but no known diabetes.
She takes no regular medications and has no prior cardiac procedure.
An electrocardiogram shows nonspecific changes; no troponin result is available.
She is awake, alert, and able to provide informed consent.

criteria.criterion_text: Myocardial infarction within the previous 6 months
Abnormal exercise myocardial perfusion scan with reversible ischemia
